description: Implementation of the SymInt class and related functions for symbolic integer operations in PyTorch's c10 namespace.

classes.name: SymInt
classes.description: A class representing symbolic integers with support for various arithmetic and comparison operations, including fast paths and slow paths for symbolic evaluation.

methods.name: promote_to_negative
methods.description: Converts a large negative number stored in data_ into a ConstantSymNodeImpl and updates data_ accordingly.

methods.name: maybe_as_int_slow_path
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the integer value if available, using a slow path.

methods.name: toSymNode
methods.description: Converts SymInt to a SymNode, with a runtime check.

methods.name: SymInt
methods.description: Constructor initializing SymInt from a SymNode.

methods.name: has_hint
methods.description: Checks if the SymInt has a hint, considering whether it is heap allocated.

methods.name: is_same
methods.description: Checks if two SymInt instances are the same.

methods.name: wrap_node
methods.description: Wraps the SymInt as a node based on a base SymNode.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the SymInt.

methods.name: guard_int
methods.description: Returns the integer value, using a guard if necessary.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Negates a SymInt, with handling for overflow.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs SymInt to stream, based on whether it is heap allocated.
